description:
`CampaignDeclaration::for_campaign` fails with "several campaign declarations name issue" when container archival leaves a byte-identical copy of a declaration under the archive root. The Rust CI gate fails on every tree that holds such a copy.

## Background

The lookup in `dev/tools/tuning-campaign-support/src/campaign.rs` identifies a declaration by content. The archive of a terminal epic copies documents that a non-terminal issue also owns, so `dev/active/dbd8787d/campaign-declaration.json` has an identical copy under `dev/archive/`. Failing CI steps: `test`, `tuning-campaign-support-nextest` and `tuning-campaign-validator`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Declarations with identical bytes count as one declaration in every lookup that selects a campaign declaration by issue or campaign identity, in the Rust tooling and in the campaign validator.
- [hard] REQ-02: Two declarations that name the same issue with different bytes remain an error, covered by a test.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test fails before the change on a tree holding a byte-identical copy and passes after it.
- [hard] REQ-04: The benchmark-acceptance verdict of every committed `zen3-benchmark-receipt-v1` receipt is identical before and after the change, shown in a linked record.
- [hard] REQ-05: The lookup contains no hard-coded `dev/` path or archive-path exclusion list; code review checks the change against `@/inv/no-dev-path-coupling`. The Rust CI gate passes.
title: Campaign declaration lookup rejects byte-identical archived copies
